nodes.question: What has been a major consequence of the Industrial Revolution as indicated in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: A major consequence of the Industrial Revolution has been the severe impact on sustainability due to an emphasis on economic growth at any cost.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the general attitude towards sustainability in the third cluster of companies?
nodes.answer: The third cluster shows no inclination towards sustainability, indicating that the topic is passively perceived without any active efforts to implement green practices or monitor resource usage and emissions.
